streaming_strategy.fit: load full series; decomposition + Nelder-Mead grid search (bounded grid).
streaming_strategy.predict: closed-form recurrence + analytic Gaussian prediction intervals.

inv.tier1_core_exception: Single-series forecasting; n<=1e6 typical; Holt-Winters fit needs full series for classical decomposition + bounded Nelder-Mead over (alpha,beta,gamma,phi). Grid cost O(n*grid_size); not a fit-matrix model.
inv.purpose: Holt-Winters exponential smoothing (additive-error, additive/multiplicative seasonality, damped trend). Classical decomposition init + bounded Nelder-Mead grid search over (alpha, beta, gamma, phi); analytic Gaussian prediction intervals. Reference: Hyndman et al. 2002.
